query: INSERT INTO apple_auth_credentials (identity_id, refresh_token_encrypted, client_id, last_validated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (identity_id) DO UPDATE SET refresh_token_encrypted = EXCLUDED.refresh_token_encrypted, client_id = EXCLUDED.client_id, last_validated_at = NOW(), revoked_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
